CLBackgroundActivitySession.doc: An object that manages a visual indicator that keeps your app in use in the background, allowing it to receive updates or events.

CLBeacon.doc: Information about an observed iBeacon device and its relative distance to a person’s device.

CLBeaconIdentityCondition.doc: A condition that describes the identity characteristics of a beacon.

CLBeaconIdentityConstraint.doc: Identity characteristics that can match one or more beacons.

CLBeaconRegion.doc: A region for detecting the presence of iBeacon devices.

CLCircularGeographicCondition.doc: A circular geographic condition that a center point and radius define.

CLCircularRegion.doc: A circular geographic region that a center point and radius deine.

CLCondition.doc: The abstract base class for all other monitor conditions.

CLGeocoder.doc: An interface for converting between geographic coordinates and place names.

CLHeading.doc: The orientation of the user’s device, relative to true or magnetic north.

CLLocationManager.doc: The object you use to start and stop the delivery of location-related events to your app.

CLLocationUpdater.doc: An object that provides device location updates.

CLMonitor.doc: An object that monitors the conditions you add to it.

CLMonitorConfiguration.doc: An object for configuring a location monitor instance.

CLMonitoringEvent.doc: The object that the framework passes to the monitor’s callback handler upon receiving an event.

CLMonitoringRecord.doc: An object that represents a condition and its associated information that a location monitor is monitoring.

CLPlacemark.doc: A user-friendly description of a geographic coordinate, often containing the name of the place, its address, and other relevant information.

CLRegion.doc: A base class representing an area that can be monitored.

CLUpdate.doc: An object that represents a location update.

CLVisit.doc: Information about the user’s location during a specific period of time.

CLLocationManagerDelegate.doc: The methods you use to receive events from an associated location-manager object.

CLLocationPushServiceExtension.doc: The interface you adopt in the type that acts as the main entry point for a Location Push Service Extension.

CLAccuracyAuthorization.doc: Constants that indicate the level of location accuracy the app has authorization to use.

CLAccuracyAuthorizationFullAccuracy.doc: The user authorized the app to access location data with full accuracy.

CLAccuracyAuthorizationReducedAccuracy.doc: The user authorized the app to access location data with reduced accuracy.

CLActivityType.doc: Constants that indicate the type of activity associated with location updates.

CLActivityTypeAirborne.doc: The value that indicates activities in the air.

CLActivityTypeAutomotiveNavigation.doc: The value that indicates positioning in an automobile following a road network.

CLActivityTypeFitness.doc: The value that indicates positioning during dedicated fitness sessions, such as walking workouts, running workouts, cycling workouts, and so on.

CLActivityTypeOther.doc: The value that indicates the app is using location manager for an unspecified activity.

CLActivityTypeOtherNavigation.doc: The value that indicates positioning for activities that don’t or may not adhere to roads such as cycling, scooters, trains, boats and off-road vehicles.

CLAuthorizationStatus.doc: Constants that indicate the app’s authorization to use location services.

kCLAuthorizationStatusAuthorized.doc: The user authorized the app to use location services.

kCLAuthorizationStatusAuthorizedAlways.doc: The user authorized the app to start location services at any time.

kCLAuthorizationStatusAuthorizedWhenInUs.doc: The user authorized the app to start location services while it is in use.

kCLAuthorizationStatusDenied.doc: The user denied the use of location services for the app or they are disabled globally in Settings.

kCLAuthorizationStatusNotDetermined.doc: The user has not chosen whether the app can use location services.

kCLAuthorizationStatusRestricted.doc: The app is not authorized to use location services.

CLDeviceOrientation.doc: Constants indicating the physical orientation of the device.

CLDeviceOrientationFaceDown.doc: The device is held parallel to the ground with the screen facing downwards.

CLDeviceOrientationFaceUp.doc: The device is held parallel to the ground with the screen facing upwards.

CLDeviceOrientationLandscapeLeft.doc: The device is in landscape mode, with the device held upright and the home button on the right side.

CLDeviceOrientationLandscapeRight.doc: The device is in landscape mode, with the device held upright and the home button on the left side.

CLDeviceOrientationPortrait.doc: The device is in portrait mode, with the device held upright and the home button at the bottom.

CLDeviceOrientationPortraitUpsideDown.doc: The device is in portrait mode but upside down, with the device held upright and the home button at the top.

CLDeviceOrientationUnknown.doc: The orientation is currently not known.

CLLiveUpdateConfiguration.doc: Specifies the types of locations that a location updater generates.

CLLiveUpdateConfigurationAirborne.doc: A configuration for airborne use cases.

CLLiveUpdateConfigurationAutomotiveNavig.doc: A configuration for automotive navigation use cases.

CLLiveUpdateConfigurationFitness.doc: A configuration for fitness use cases.

CLLiveUpdateConfigurationOtherNavigation.doc: A configuration for other navigation use cases.

CLLocationPushServiceError.doc: Error codes the location manager returns if starting to monitor for location push notifications fails.

CLMonitoringState.doc: Values that represent the current state of a monitoring condition.

CLMonitoringStateSatisfied.doc: The condition is in a satisfied state.

CLMonitoringStateUnknown.doc: The condition is in an unknown state.

CLMonitoringStateUnmonitored.doc: The condition is in an unmonitored state.

CLMonitoringStateUnsatisfied.doc: The condition is in an unsatisfied state.

CLProximity.doc: Constants that reflect the relative distance to a beacon.

CLProximityImmediate.doc: The beacon is in the user’s immediate vicinity.

CLProximityNear.doc: The beacon is relatively close to the user.

CLProximityUnknown.doc: The proximity of the beacon could not be determined.

CLRegionState.doc: Constants that reflect the relationship of the current location to the region boundaries.

CLRegionStateInside.doc: The location is inside of the given region.

CLRegionStateOutside.doc: The location is outside of the given region.

CLRegionStateUnknown.doc: It is unknown whether the location is inside or outside of the region.

CLLocationCoordinate2D.doc: The latitude and longitude associated with a location, specified using the WGS 84 reference frame.

-initWithUUID:.doc: Creates a new beacon identity condition with the identifier you specify.

-initWithUUID:major:.doc: Creates a new beacon identity condition with the identifier and major value you specify.

-initWithUUID:major:minor:.doc: Creates a new beacon identity condition with the identifier, and major and minor values you specify.

-initWithBeaconIdentityConstraint:identi.doc: Creates and returns a region object that targets beacons that satisfy the specified beacon identity constraints.

-initWithProximityUUID:identifier:.doc: Creates and returns a region object that targets a beacon with the specified UUID.

-initWithProximityUUID:major:identifier:.doc: Creates and returns a region object that targets a beacon with the specified proximity ID and major value.

-initWithProximityUUID:major:minor:ident.doc: Creates and returns a region object that targets a beacon with the specified proximity ID, major value, and minor value.

-initWithUUID:identifier:.doc: Creates and returns a region object that targets beacons with the specified UUID.

-initWithUUID:major:identifier:.doc: Creates and returns a region object that targets beacons with the specified UUID and major value.

-initWithUUID:major:minor:identifier:.doc: Creates and returns a region object that targets beacons with the specified UUID, and major and minor values.

-peripheralDataWithMeasuredPower:.doc: Retrieves data that you can use to advertise the current device as a beacon.

-initWithCenter:radius:.doc: Creates a new circular geographic condition with the center point and radius you provide.

-containsCoordinate:.doc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether the geographic area contains the specified coordinate.

-initWithCenter:radius:identifier:.doc: Creates and returns a region object defining a circular geographic area.

-geocodeAddressDictionary:completionHand.doc: Submits a forward-geocoding request using the specified address dictionary.

-geocodeAddressString:completionHandler:.doc: Submits a forward-geocoding request using the specified string.

-geocodeAddressString:inRegion:completio.doc: Submits a forward-geocoding request using the specified string and region information.

-geocodeAddressString:inRegion:preferred.doc: Submits a forward-geocoding requesting using the specified address string and locale information.

-geocodePostalAddress:completionHandler:.doc: Submits a forward-geocoding requesting using the specified Contacts framework information.

-geocodePostalAddress:preferredLocale:co.doc: Submits a forward-geocoding requesting using the specified locale and Contacts framework information.

-reverseGeocodeLocation:completionHandle.doc: Submits a reverse-geocoding request for the specified location.

-reverseGeocodeLocation:preferredLocale:.doc: Submits a reverse-geocoding request for the specified location and locale.

+headingAvailable.doc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether the location manager is able to generate heading-related events.

+isMonitoringAvailableForClass:.doc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether the device supports region monitoring using the specified class.

+isRangingAvailable.doc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether the device supports ranging of beacons that use the iBeacon protocol.

+locationServicesEnabled.doc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether location services are enabled on the device.

+significantLocationChangeMonitoringAvai.doc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether the significant-change location service is available on the device.

-dismissHeadingCalibrationDisplay.doc: Dismisses the heading calibration view from the screen immediately.

-requestAlwaysAuthorization.doc: Requests the user’s permission to use location services regardless of whether the app is in use.

-requestLocation.doc: Requests the one-time delivery of the user’s current location.

-requestTemporaryFullAccuracyAuthorizati.doc: Requests permission to temporarily use location services with full accuracy.
Requests permission to temporarily use location services with full accuracy and reports the results to the provided completion handler.

-requestWhenInUseAuthorization.doc: Requests the user’s permission to use location services while the app is in use.

-startMonitoringLocationPushesWithComple.doc: Starts monitoring for the delivery of Apple Push Notification service (APNs) location pushes, and provides a device-specific token for sending pushes.

-startMonitoringSignificantLocationChang.doc: Starts the generation of updates based on significant location changes.

-startMonitoringVisits.doc: Starts the delivery of visit-related events.

-startRangingBeaconsSatisfyingConstraint.doc: Starts the delivery of notifications for the specified beacon constraints.

-startUpdatingHeading.doc: Starts the generation of updates that report the user’s current heading.

-startUpdatingLocation.doc: Starts the generation of updates that report the user’s current location.

-stopMonitoringLocationPushes.doc: Stops monitoring for Apple Push Notification service (APNs) location pushes.

-stopMonitoringSignificantLocationChange.doc: Stops the delivery of location events based on significant location changes.

-stopMonitoringVisits.doc: Stops the delivery of visit-related events.

-stopRangingBeaconsSatisfyingConstraint:.doc: Stops the delivery of notifications for the specified beacon constraints.

-stopUpdatingHeading.doc: Stops the generation of heading updates.

-stopUpdatingLocation.doc: Stops the generation of location updates.

+liveUpdaterWithConfiguration:queue:hand.doc: Creates a location updater with the configuration and queue that you specify.

+liveUpdaterWithQueue:handler:.doc: Creates a location updater on the queue you specify.

+configWithMonitorName:queue:eventHandle.doc: Creates a location monitor instance with the name, dispatch queue, and event handler you specify.

-initWithPlacemark:.doc: Initializes and returns a placemark object from another placemark object.

-containsCoordinate:.doc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether the region contains the specified coordinate.

-initCircularRegionWithCenter:radius:ide.doc: Initializes and returns a region object defining a circular area.

UUID.doc: The UUID that the observed beacon transmitted.

accuracy.doc: The accuracy of the proximity value, measured in meters from the beacon.

major.doc: The major value that the observed beacon transmitted.

minor.doc: The minor value that the observed beacon transmitted.

proximity.doc: The relative distance to the beacon.

proximityUUID.doc: The proximity ID of the beacon.

rssi.doc: The received signal strength of the beacon, measured in decibels.

timestamp.doc: A timestamp representing when the beacon was observed.

UUID.doc: A universally unique identifier that represent the beacon’s identifier.

major.doc: The most significant value associated with the beacon.

minor.doc: The least significant value associated with the beacon.

major.doc: The constraint’s value for the major identity characteristic.

minor.doc: The constraint’s value for the minor identity characteristic.

UUID.doc: The UUID value from the beacon identity constraint that defines the beacon region.

beaconIdentityConstraint.doc: The beacon identity constraint that defines the beacon region.

major.doc: The major value from the beacon identity constraint that defines the beacon region.

minor.doc: The minor value from the beacon identity constraint that defines the beacon region.

notifyEntryStateOnDisplay.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether Core Location sends beacon notifications when the device’s display is on.

proximityUUID.doc: The unique ID of the beacons you’re targeting.

center.doc: The center of the circular geographic condition.

radius.doc: The radius of the circular geographic condition.

center.doc: The center point of the geographic area.

radius.doc: The radius (measured in meters) that defines the geographic area’s outer boundary.

geocoding.doc: A Boolean value indicating whether the receiver is in the middle of geocoding its value.

headingAccuracy.doc: The maximum deviation (measured in degrees) between the reported heading and the true geomagnetic heading.

magneticHeading.doc: The heading (measured in degrees) relative to magnetic north.

timestamp.doc: The time at which this heading was determined.

trueHeading.doc: The heading (measured in degrees) relative to true north.

x.doc: The geomagnetic data (measured in microteslas) for the x-axis.

y.doc: The geomagnetic data (measured in microteslas) for the y-axis.

z.doc: The geomagnetic data (measured in microteslas) for the z-axis.

accuracyAuthorization.doc: A value that indicates the level of location accuracy the app has permission to use.

activityType.doc: The type of activity the app expects the user to typically perform while in the app’s location session.

allowsBackgroundLocationUpdates.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the app receives location updates when running in the background.

authorizationStatus.doc: The current authorization status for the app.

authorizedForWidgetUpdates.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether a widget is eligible to receive location updates.

delegate.doc: The delegate object to receive update events.

desiredAccuracy.doc: The accuracy of the location data that your app wants to receive.

distanceFilter.doc: The minimum distance in meters the device must move horizontally before an update event is generated.

headingFilter.doc: The minimum angular change in degrees required to generate new heading events.

headingOrientation.doc: The device orientation to use when computing heading values.

location.doc: The most recently retrieved user location.

maximumRegionMonitoringDistance.doc: The largest boundary distance that can be assigned to a region.

monitoredRegions.doc: The set of shared regions monitored by all location-manager objects.

pausesLocationUpdatesAutomatically.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the location-manager object may pause location updates.

rangedBeaconConstraints.doc: The set of beacon constraints currently being tracked using ranging.

showsBackgroundLocationIndicator.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the status bar changes its appearance when an app uses location services in the background.

eventHandler.doc: The block the framework calls as the event handler for the location monitor instance.

name.doc: The name of the monitor instance.

queue.doc: The dispatch queue to bind the instance of a location monitor to.

accuracyLimited.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the app receives accuracy-limited location updates.

authorizationDenied.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the app has local authorization.

authorizationDeniedGlobally.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the app has system-wide authorization.

authorizationRestricted.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the app can make authorization changes.

conditionLimitExceeded.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the app receives location updates based on other monitoring conditions.

conditionUnsupported.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the app receives location updates based on the supported condition.

identifier.doc: A string that represents the identifier of a monitored condition.

insufficientlyInUse.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the app receives location updates because it’s insufficiently in use.

persistenceUnavailable.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether it receives location updates based on successful persistence.

refinement.doc: An optional instance of a condition that represents the most specific condition to that this event can apply to.

state.doc: The state of the condition at the time of the event.

condition.doc: The condition that the framework is monitoring events for.

lastEvent.doc: An object that contains the specifics of the most recent event.

ISOcountryCode.doc: The abbreviated country or region name.

addressDictionary.doc: A dictionary containing the Address Book keys and values for the placemark.

administrativeArea.doc: The state or province associated with the placemark.

areasOfInterest.doc: The relevant areas of interest associated with the placemark.

country.doc: The name of the country or region associated with the placemark.

inlandWater.doc: The name of the inland water body associated with the placemark.

locality.doc: The city associated with the placemark.

location.doc: The location object containing latitude and longitude information.

ocean.doc: The name of the ocean associated with the placemark.

postalAddress.doc: The postal address associated with the location, formatted for use with the Contacts framework.

postalCode.doc: The postal code associated with the placemark.

region.doc: The geographic region associated with the placemark.

subAdministrativeArea.doc: Additional administrative area information for the placemark.

subLocality.doc: Additional city-level information for the placemark.

subThoroughfare.doc: Additional street-level information for the placemark.

thoroughfare.doc: The street address associated with the placemark.

timeZone.doc: The time zone associated with the placemark.

center.doc: The center point of the region.

identifier.doc: The identifier for the region object.

notifyOnEntry.doc: A Boolean indicating that notifications are generated upon entry into the region.

notifyOnExit.doc: A Boolean indicating that notifications are generated upon exit from the region.

radius.doc: The radius (measured in meters) that defines the region’s outer boundary.

alwaysAuthorizationDenied.doc: A Boolean value that indicates someone has not granted the always authorization to your app.

isStationary.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the device is stationary.

arrivalDate.doc: The approximate time at which the user arrived at the specified location.

departureDate.doc: The approximate time at which the user left the specified location.

horizontalAccuracy.doc: The horizontal accuracy (in meters) of the specified coordinate.
